extraction_notes: Rates read from figures are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 5 and Figure 6 report normalized rates/conversion or stability traces without absolute NH3 synthesis rates and were not enumerated as plant-model performance records. Figure 4a and several overlapping K-promoter traces in Figure 4b were too crowded to digitize reliably beyond the unambiguous promoter series included here. Literature-comparison activation energies and cited literature rates were excluded.
